incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired for service="inference-proxy" severity=high -> routed to 'platform-night-proxy' (page_id=PD12345678)
Platform Night Ops: got it, paging chain started.
Sophie C.: wait — inference-proxy should go to infra-oncall for prod incidents, not night-proxy. why did this route? :eyes:
Miguel R.: looks like the PD service alias change from this morning may have created a duplicate binding. checking PD mappings now.
pagerbot: PD event received: event_id=evt-88a2, service=inference-proxy, routing_key=RK-night-proxy, escalation_policy=night-proxy-ep
Priya N.: @Miguel R. any quick way to reassign the active page? customers are reporting elevated latency on generation endpoints, small set though.
Alex L. (oncall): I'm seeing bulk 503s in the proxy logs right now, clients timed out at ~23:41 UTC. tagging customers: cust-chi, cust-delta, cust-beta.
Miguel R.: ok confirmed: PD service alias "inference-proxy" accidentally mapped to the night-proxy routing_key when we created the v2 alias earlier. there is a duplicate service entry.
Sophie C.: could we escalate to infra-oncall and re-route the page? we need someone with access to the proxy pool.
Miguel R.: doing a PD reroute now. command: `pd-cli reroute-service --service inference-proxy --target infra-oncall`
pagerbot: reroute command accepted, new target infra-oncall. PD note added: "manual reroute by Miguel R."
incident-bot: page re-routed, new page created PD12345999 -> infra-oncall. previous page PD12345678 auto-ack now.
Alex L. (oncall): infra-oncall acked PD12345999 (Alex L.). moving to triage. initial mitigation: scaled proxy pool by +2 instances, draining one suspect node. logs: ```
[23:40:12] proxy-01  ERROR  kv-cache OOM for client 10.2.4.6
[23:41:03] proxy-04  WARN   connection reset by peer
[23:41:05] proxy-03  INFO   draining connections
```
Priya N.: scaling helped — 5xx rate dropped from 12% -> 1.8% over last 3m. customers affected see decreased errors but still some slow tails.
Sophie C.: what's root cause? config drift? hot cache eviction?
Miguel R.: hypothesis: a new routing policy for proxy v2 introduced aggressive KV cache TTL lowering; under burst traffic this caused eviction storms and backpressure to upstreams. the config roll was staged this morning and targeted night cluster; somehow the PD alias creation ran the wrong metadata set.
Platform Night Ops: note — the night-proxy service alias was touched in the morning rollout by @olivia (deploy bot). we should audit the deploy.
Sophie C.: action items for now: 1) rollback KV TTL change on night cluster (Miguel), 2) confirm PD service entries and remove duplicate alias (Priya), 3) follow-up postmortem + runbook update (Sophie).
Miguel R.: rolling back KV TTL on night cluster now: `kubectl -n inference set env deploy/proxy KEYV_TTL=300` -> applying...
pagerbot: infra-oncall updated PD note: "mitigation in progress: rollback TTL + scale pool"
Alex L. (oncall): confirmed rollback applied, metrics look stable. will keep an eye for 15m.
Priya N.: removed duplicate PD alias and added a guard in meta-service to fail on duplicate routing_keys. PD mapping validated.
Sophie C.: customer impact summary: 3 paying customers experienced short elevated error rates and latency spikes for ~14 minutes (23:37–23:51 UTC). no data loss. refunds not indicated but CS notified.
Platform Night Ops: adding temporary monitor alert to catch TTL-related eviction spikes.
Miguel R.: root cause draft: misapplied PD service alias + risky TTL change deployed to night cluster without adequate canary.
Sophie C.: thanks team. immediate next: postmortem timeline, action owners: Miguel (rollback + improved canary), Priya (PD alias validation + guard), Sophie (postmortem + runbook).
Alex L. (oncall): leaving a handoff note for morning shift: confirm PD aliases stable, verify proxy TTL config across clusters, and run a synthetic traffic test against inference-proxy.
Priya N.: marking incident resolved for paging. will close PD incidents once morning verification complete. :white_check_mark:
Sophie C.: adding retention note: escalate to oncall policy WG to require explicit PR for PD alias changes.
incident-bot: Incident thread closed by Sophie C. (summary posted to #postmortems will follow).
Sophie C.: postmortem TODOs: add timeline, mitigation commands, alert signature, and customer communications draft. assigning owners in a follow-up thread. :memo:
